source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Dialog options independently hide Block, Session and Allow. The URL field and its label are hidden together when all three actions are hidden. onHostInput disables all three actions for an empty value. Preserve these two states in this dialog rather than replacing hidden with disabled or vice versa. The current remote-content test checks that Session is hidden after adding entries; no live accessibility inspection ran. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: Keep permissions-control visibility separate from empty-input enablement
